title: Instruction segments for a compiled call
statement: Let $G$ be a code layout with $F$ local variables per frame and a list of procedure entry positions, and let $code$ be a finite instruction list. Suppose the compiled call to procedure $p$ with arguments $args$, storing its result in variable $x$ and starting at position $pos$, is a prefix of the code beginning at $pos$. Then the argument-evaluation instructions followed by the instructions that initialise a new frame form a prefix beginning at $pos$; the branch to procedure $p$’s entry position (or position $0$ if the list has no entry at index $p$) forms a prefix beginning at $pos+\mathrm{argsSize}(args)+2F+4$; and the two instructions that store the call result form a prefix beginning at $pos+\mathrm{callSize}(F,args)$.
